ecus.name: On-board charger (7-22 kW, 400 V and 800 V; PFC + isolated DC-DC, often bidirectional)
ecus.function: AC grid to HV battery: power-factor-correction stage (totem-pole / 3-phase) then an isolated LLC / CLLC / DAB DC-DC stage; bidirectional units also supply V2L / V2G. Increasingly integrated with the HV-LV DC-DC in one housing.

pcb.layers: 8 layers on the TI TIDM-02013 / PMP22650 7.4 kW GaN OBC power board (reference design; a TI E2E user reports the Gerber package as 8 layers with inner layers 2-7 missing). Production OBC layer counts: not published in any source found.
pcb.size: not published in any source found. PMP22650 reports 3.8 kW/L open-frame power density (reference design).
pcb.technology: Power stage on insulated metal substrate in several designs: Fraunhofer IISB 3.6 kW OBC puts all SiC devices on an IMS over the coolant; Wolfspeed CRD-22DD12N-J2 mounts TO-263-7 SiC on an IMS board. Top-side-cooled SMD packages (QDPAK / DDPAK, T2PAK, Wolfspeed U2) move device heat to a heatsink above the board instead of through vias / IMS. Separate control board(s) carry the DSP/MCU.
pcb.laminate: not published in any source found
pcb.boards: Hyundai E-GMP ICCU (11 kW OBC + 12 V LDC): 4 PCBs, 3 in the main box, the top one carrying the DSP (forum investigation by an electrical engineer, not a formal teardown). Wolfspeed CRD-22DD12N: main, controller and auxiliary boards. ST STDES-7KWOBC: one 7 kW module, paralleled or 3-phase to 21 kW.
pcb.basis: layers: https://e2e.ti.com/f/1/t/1308009 ; size: https://www.ti.com/tool/PMP22650 ; technology: https://iisb.fraunhofer.de/content/dam/iisb2014/en/Documents/Research-Areas/power_electronics/Modular-3-6kW-On-Board-Charger_FraunhoferIISB_1V1_WWW.pdf , https://www.wolfspeed.com/products/power/reference-designs/crd-22dd12n-j2/ , https://powersystemsdesign.com/articles/top-side-cooling-in-obc-applications/22/21741 ; boards: https://www.goingelectric.de/forum/viewtopic.php?p=2381724 , https://www.wolfspeed.com/crd-22dd12n , https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/stdes-7kwobc.html

teardowns.title: Yole SystemPlus: What's in the box? Chinese automotive electrification systems at a glance
teardowns.finding: UAES OBC and VMAX combined charging unit: low-tech parts (mechanics, fuses, relays, inductors, film caps) local; MCU, ICs, Si/SiC discretes and electrolytics imported; non-Chinese parts ~40% of material cost; some SiC chips integrated.

teardowns.title: GoingElectric forum: Hyundai Ioniq 5 ICCU investigation (forum, not a formal teardown)
teardowns.finding: ICCU = 11 kW OBC (partly reversible for V2L) + 12 V LDC; 4 PCBs, 3 in the main box; DSP drives all SiC switches; LDC is a single-switch active-clamp forward under a separate LTC3752-2; ~300 failures collected Jan 2024-Nov 2025.

teardowns.title: TI TIDM-02013 / PMP22650 7.4 kW bidirectional OBC (reference design, not production)

teardowns.title: onsemi SEC-3PH-11-OBC-EVB 11 kW 3-phase OBC platform (reference design)

teardowns.title: ST STDES-7KWOBC 7 kW OBC (reference design)

teardowns.title: Wolfspeed CRD-22DD12N 22 kW bidirectional DC/DC for OBC (reference design)

boardCostEvidence.claim: US DOE VTO 2014 merit review: OBCs were expensive - $273 for a tier-one 3.3 kW charger, about one third of the cost in passive components.
Industry analysis (pre-2020 projection): on-board charger price $130-230 per kW, expected to fall 20-25% within 2020; DC-DC stage and PFC are the largest cost shares.
Forum-quoted GM service-part listing: Chevrolet Volt 3.6 kW charger $458.84 (a service-part price, not a production cost).
Yole SystemPlus: in a UAES OBC and a VMAX combined charging unit, parts made outside China are ~40% of total material cost (share only; absolute figures paywalled).
Foccci open CCS controller (hobby quantities): about EUR 25 for the populated PCB, EUR 12 for the QCA7005, EUR 4 for two NCV8402 drivers, EUR 1 for the RF transformer, under EUR 1 for connectors.

notes: No public absolute cost or teardown ASP for a production OBC, HV DC-DC, 48 V DC-DC or EVCC board was found; Munro and Yole cost figures for these units are paywalled. Munro's public figures are for inverters only.

Production chip identity found only from community / forum sources: Hyundai Ioniq CCM (QCA7005) and Hyundai E-GMP ICCU (LTC3752-2 LDC controller; DSP and SiC maker not named). Tesla PCS / PCS2, VW MEB OBC, BYD 8-in-1 and Ford units were searched without a named IC.
The library's 'FFSH3065B' for the onsemi 11 kW kit: onsemi's announcement names FFSB3065B-F085 (D2PAK); researched under that code.
The library's 'QCA7005 (AEC-Q100 Grade 3)': the sources found give AEC-Q100 Grade 2 for QCA7006AQ, MSE1022 and IS32CG5317; no source found stated QCA7005's grade.
Placements: no source states a component count for any of the four boards; left as not published.
